title: Apple hit by widespread outages as tech problems continue
script: This is World Pulse Daily with a quick news update. The main headline is this: Apple hit by widespread outages as tech problems continue. In simple words, Apple Business, AppleCare, the App Store, Apple Music and other popular consumer-facing services were impacted by outages amid a recent surge in technical issues that impacted email, air travel, and online. Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update. Follow trusted sources before sharing developing claims.
